definitions.mean_pairwise_correlation: for each completed date, compute rolling Pearson correlation over corr_window completed daily returns for every unordered pair of non-BTC assets with full window availability; statistic is arithmetic mean of those pair correlations
definitions.lagged_correlation_quantile: rolling quantile of the correlation statistic shifted by one completed bar before the quantile window, so the current correlation observation is not used to set its own threshold
definitions.relative_strength_breadth: arithmetic fraction of available non-BTC assets whose exact close-to-close return over return_window completed bars is strictly greater than BTC return over the same bars
definitions.downside_participation: within the trailing participation_window completed bars, arithmetic mean of daily fractions of available non-BTC assets with negative daily return, restricted to bars where BTC daily return is negative; fewer than minimum_btc_down_observations forces risk_off
definitions.shock_recovery_alt_5d_return: arithmetic mean across available non-BTC assets of each asset's exact close-to-close return over recovery_window completed bars; no cross-day compounding of the equal-weight basket
definitions.shock_recovery_state_order: on each completed bar evaluate shock first; a shock sets risk_off even if recovery threshold is simultaneously met; only when no shock is present may the recovery condition switch risk_on

missing_asset_rule: use available assets only if total panel still satisfies minimum_loaded_assets; no replacement, interpolation, symbol substitution or forward filling of prices
